- if local `method` == 'pbkdf2': the Python `repr()` of the 3-tuple `(method, hash_name, iterations)`.
All values are the actual Python objects held by those locals (str or int), so e.g. a hypothetical entry looks like `('scrypt', 123)` or `('pbkdf2', 'sha3_256', 7)` (single-quoted strings, ints without separators or quotes, ", " between items).

Answer with JSON `{"unique_values": [...]}`: the list of DISTINCT entry strings (duplicates removed), sorted ascending by plain Python string comparison of the repr strings (Unicode code-point / lexicographic order, NOT numeric order).
